title: Standards-alignment matrix and gap analysis — Oracle, Mem0, Microsoft
summary: Research-only: map every existing benchmark epic onto the Oracle/Mem0/Microsoft methodology it corresponds to, confirm the agent-quality axis is the only real gap, and land the findings as a dated DECISIONS.md entry.
description:
Produce a three-column alignment matrix (vendor axis -> this repo's epic/story -> status) covering: (1) **Oracle** — TPC-style latency/throughput/workload profiling, satisfied by EPIC-13 (pytest-benchmark foundation), EPIC-14 (single-op coverage), EPIC-15 (Locust concurrency/scale), EPIC-17 (CI tiering on runner-invariant signals), EPIC-18 (Db2-specific depth); (2) **Mem0** — retrieval accuracy / context retention / relevance scoring / long-vs-short-term memory evaluation, satisfied by EPIC-16 (real LongMemEval dataset + Recall@k/MRR/nDCG@k), EPIC-6 (root-caused accuracy gap), EPIC-11's TRU-4 (embedding-provider re-run) and TRU-5 (token-efficiency figure vs. Mem0's published ~7K-tokens/query number); (3) **Microsoft** — AutoGen/Semantic Kernel/Azure AI Foundry task-completion rate, faithfulness, groundedness, and coherence, currently unsatisfied (confirmed by grepping project-management/ for these terms plus AutoGen/Azure AI Foundry — zero benchmark hits as of this story), closed by EPIC-21.

Explicitly re-verify (don't assume from memory) the current Microsoft Foundry built-in-evaluator names and scale (learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/concepts/built-in-evaluators) and the AgentEval paper's criteria (arXiv 2402.09015) before writing the matrix, since EPIC-21's own description already flags this evaluator set has changed twice in 2026. Also record what is deliberately out of scope: this SDK will not depend on the `azure-ai-evaluation` PyPI package (see EPIC-21/AGQ-1 rationale) and will not attempt TPC-C/TPC-H-style database-level benchmarking (already rejected in BENCHMARK_STRATEGY.md's HammerDB/VectorDBBench section — measures the database, not the SDK).

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Matrix covers all three vendor axes with explicit epic/story references, not vague claims.
- Every current Microsoft Learn / arXiv citation re-verified live, not recalled from an earlier conversation, with the verification date recorded.
- Explicit statement of what remains a gap after EPIC-21 lands (if anything) vs. what is now closed.

**Definition of Done:**
- Dated DECISIONS.md entry added following the existing entry format (see EPIC-11's 2026-08-04 entry for structure).
- No code changes — this is a planning/research story, same discipline as BM-1 (EPIC-13) and BENCH-1's diagnostic-only scope (EPIC-6).
- Independent of UNI-2/UNI-3; both should read this entry before starting but are not blocked waiting for it if the matrix content is already understood from this story's board description.
